lines.text: PongLens is a performance hub for competitive table tennis.

lines.label: Bring a match in
lines.text: Get any match in from your phone, or straight from YouTube.

lines.label: Every point, cut out
lines.text: It comes back as pure table tennis. The standing around is gone, and what is left is every point you played.

lines.label: Built for studying
lines.text: With playback built for studying the game, right down to a single shot.

lines.label: Ten minutes to score
lines.text: Score the whole match in about ten minutes, just by saying who won each point.

lines.label: Ten minutes to score
lines.text: And every point you call becomes the data your analysis is built on.

lines.label: What the match says
lines.text: A scored match can answer real questions you didn't know before, like how many points you win off serve receive, and how you perform during high pressure points.

lines.label: Over time
lines.text: Keep scoring, and the same picture builds over time.

lines.label: Where the ball went
lines.text: Placement maps show what your opponent kept doing to you, and what kept working for you.

lines.label: You and your coach
lines.text: And your coach can review the real match from anywhere. They can drop a written comment, draw on the frame, or leave a voice note on that exact point.

lines.label: A review from a pro
lines.text: Or get your match professionally reviewed, with what is costing you points and the exact points to watch.

lines.label: One journal
lines.text: Lessons, notes, even pages from your notebook end up in one searchable journal.

lines.label: One journal
lines.text: And Recollect turns your lessons into practice cards, so the coaching sticks.

lines.label: Share the good ones
lines.text: When a rally deserves an audience, export one point or the whole match for social media,

lines.label: Share the good ones
lines.text: with the score burned into the picture, so it reads like a real match wherever you post it.

lines.label: Share the good ones
lines.text: Or share the same points as a link, so friends and family can watch the highlights.
PongLens. Film the match once. Learn from it all year.
